text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hey there, Traineroonie.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While I'm strolling through the academy
one
evening, Seiun Sky waves me over
for another
session of the murder
mystery game.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Okay, so let's continue from where we
left off.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Last time, we discovered that the
poisoned egg
custard had been switched
out. The original was
in a yellow bowl,
but the poisoned one was in a
blue bowl.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
And since El visited King's room after
the meal
was served, she's looking
pretty sus right now.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no! It was just a coincidence that
I
dropped by after the food was served!
There's no
proof that it was me!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's true. Which just means we're
gonna
have to continue our
investigation.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
All right, this marks the start of phase
two.
Trainer, please read the script.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As requested, I check the instructions in
the GM
script. It looks like the next step
is...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Secrets? Are we all supposed to have
one?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yep—looks like they're written in our

individual booklets. It should say "secret
for
phase two only" on it.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
We might end up with a different
suspect once we
hear this new
information. ...What do you think,

everyone?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
We might indeed. Well then, may I
speak first?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The truth is... after I served the food,
King went
to the bathroom. It seemed as
if she'd forgotten
something.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...What?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh? So you're saying that King left the
room after
the food was served.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Curious indeed, don't you think? If King
left the
room after her food was served,
then anybody
could have snuck in
without being spotted.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
In other words, anyone could have
switched the
bowls... And so, everybody
is a suspect.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Bueno! That means I'm not the only
suspect
anymore!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
And I've got a special secret of my own
to reveal!
So, actually, when I went to
see King...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The bowl was already blue! Meaning the
culprit
had already entered the room!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it was already blue? That's a rather
intriguing
piece of information.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The more we know, the easier it'll be to
narrow
down the suspects. Spe, Sei, care
to share your
secrets?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
O-okay, I've got something too... So,
actually, I
was with Grass from just after
she served dinner
right up until we all
gathered here. But while we
were
together...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I caught a very brief glimpse of Sei
walking along
holding something...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oh? You saw me?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Interesting. She was holding something?
It
couldn't have been... a yellow bowl,
could it?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Sherlock here's giving me the

heebie-jeebies. So the spotlight of
suspicion's
shining on me now, huh?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, this isn't looking too good... Hey,
help me
out here, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, nice job backing me up there.
Yep, I'm a
housekeeper, so I carry all
kinds of cleaning
supplies around with
me.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Hmm... That's actually muy sospechosa. I mean, this is Sei we're talking about here.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hey now, first the spotlight and now the
shade?
Who do you take me for?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: But anyways... You caught me...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Everyone waits with bated breath to see
how the
cornered Seiun Sky will
respond.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Spe's telling the truth. I was walking around the inn holding something.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Surprisingly, she openly admits to it. Is
she
planning something here?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Ordinary" is subjective. Maybe I'm
actually the
best housekeeper in the
world. Nya-ha-ha.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
But for real, that was more of a sabotage
than a
helping hand. You're making this
harder.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: But anyways... If you really must know...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Everyone waits with bated breath to see
how the
cornered Seiun Sky will
respond.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Spe's telling the truth. I was walking around the inn holding something.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Surprisingly, she openly admits to it. Is
she
planning something here?
